quests.instruction: You are about to go down a very tall, twisty slide for the first time. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Trying something new and a little bit high up can make your tummy do flips.
quests.explanation: Trying something new and high up for the first time can feel a little nerve-racking.
quests.funFact: Taking a deep breath before trying something new can help you feel brave!

quests.instruction: Your best friend moves far away. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Missing someone you love to play with can bring tears to your eyes.
quests.explanation: Missing someone special can bring on this quiet, heavy feeling.
quests.funFact: You can still stay close to faraway friends with letters, calls, or video chats!

quests.instruction: Someone scribbles on the picture you were drawing. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Seeing your hard work get messed up can make your fists feel tight.
quests.explanation: Seeing your work get ruined by someone else is a very frustrating feeling.
quests.funFact: Asking for a new sheet of paper can help you start fresh after an accident.

quests.instruction: You get a shiny new bike to ride to the park. How do you feel?
quests.hint: A brand new way to zoom around can make you want to hop on right away.
quests.explanation: A brand-new bike to ride fills you with eager, zoomy energy.
quests.funFact: Learning to balance on two wheels is a big, exciting milestone for many kids!

quests.instruction: You eat a big scoop of your favorite ice cream. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Yummy treats often bring a big smile to your face.
quests.explanation: Enjoying a favorite treat is a simple, happy little moment.
quests.funFact: Your favorite tastes can bring back happy memories in your brain!

quests.instruction: The wind howls loudly against your window at night. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Eerie sounds outside at night can make it hard to fall asleep.
quests.explanation: Eerie sounds in the dark can make your body feel tense and unsure.
quests.funFact: A soft nightlight can help make nighttime sounds feel much less spooky.

quests.instruction: Your favorite toy breaks. How do you feel?
quests.hint: When something you love gets broken, your heart feels a little heavy.
quests.explanation: Losing something you love, even a toy, can make your heart feel heavy for a while.
quests.funFact: Sometimes broken toys can even be fixed — that can turn this feeling into a hopeful one!

quests.instruction: Your friend keeps interrupting you every time you try to speak. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Not being able to finish what you are saying can feel very frustrating.
quests.explanation: It feels frustrating when you keep getting interrupted and cannot finish talking.
quests.funFact: Saying 'please let me finish' can help friends learn to take turns talking.

quests.instruction: It is almost time for the school fair with games and prizes. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Thinking about games and prizes waiting for you can make you talk extra fast.
quests.explanation: Thinking about games and prizes ahead fills you with eager, happy energy.
quests.funFact: School fairs often take teachers weeks to plan, just so the day feels extra special!

quests.instruction: You blow out your birthday candles. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Birthdays are full of cake, songs, and smiles.
quests.explanation: Birthdays are special days that fill us with joy and happy wishes.
quests.funFact: Blowing out candles and making a wish is a happy birthday tradition!

quests.instruction: You get separated from your family for a moment in a busy crowd. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Not being able to see someone you rely on can make your chest feel tight.
quests.explanation: Not seeing a grown-up you rely on, even for a moment, feels very unsettling.
quests.funFact: Staying still and looking for a helper in a uniform is a brave first step!

quests.instruction: Your paper airplane gets stuck high up in a tree. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Losing something you made with your own hands can bring a small frown.
quests.explanation: Losing something you made yourself can leave you feeling a little blue.
quests.funFact: Paper airplanes fly best with light paper and a few careful, even folds!

quests.instruction: Someone cuts in front of you in line. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Waiting your turn and having someone skip ahead does not feel fair.
quests.explanation: It feels unfair when someone skips ahead of you after you waited your turn.
quests.funFact: Lines help everyone get a fair turn — that is why we use them!

quests.instruction: Grandma is arriving to visit this afternoon. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Waiting by the window for someone special can make the minutes feel long.
quests.explanation: Waiting for someone special to arrive fills the day with happy anticipation.
quests.funFact: Making a small welcome sign is a fun way to use extra eager energy!

quests.instruction: You play your favorite game with your dog. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Playing with a pet you love usually brings a big smile.
quests.explanation: Playing games with a pet you love is a happy way to spend your time.
quests.funFact: Playing with pets can make both you and your pet feel joyful!

quests.instruction: A spider quickly scurries across the floor near your feet. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Small, fast, surprising movements can make you want to jump back.
quests.explanation: Fast, sudden movements from a little critter can give you a jumpy feeling.
quests.funFact: Most house spiders are harmless and actually help by catching other bugs!

quests.instruction: Waves wash away the sandcastle you built all afternoon. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Watching hard work disappear can make your eyes feel a little watery.
quests.explanation: Watching something you worked hard on disappear can feel like a small loss.
quests.funFact: Even sandcastle experts know the ocean always washes castles away eventually!

quests.instruction: Someone knocks over the sandcastle you just finished. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Watching your hard work get ruined right after you finished can be upsetting.
quests.explanation: Finishing something and then watching it get ruined is a frustrating feeling.
quests.funFact: Building right next to the water is fun, but sandcastles never last forever!

quests.instruction: Your family just told you about an upcoming trip to the beach. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Hearing about a fun trip coming soon can make you want to jump up and down.
quests.explanation: Hearing about a fun trip ahead can fill you with happy, bouncy energy.
quests.funFact: Planning fun trips ahead of time can make the wait feel like part of the adventure!

quests.instruction: You draw a picture of your whole family. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Making something for the people you love feels nice.
quests.explanation: Creating something for the people you love is a happy little project.
quests.funFact: Drawing and coloring can help children feel calm and happy while they create!

quests.instruction: You hear a loud clap of thunder at night. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Loud, sudden sounds in the dark can make your heart beat fast.
quests.explanation: Loud, sudden sounds at night can give you a jumpy, nervous feeling.
quests.funFact: Thunder is just the sound made by lightning heating the air super fast!

quests.instruction: Rain cancels the picnic you planned all week. How do you feel?
quests.hint: When a fun plan does not happen, your shoulders might droop a little.
quests.explanation: When something we looked forward to does not happen, it is normal to feel down.
quests.funFact: You can always plan a fun rainy-day picnic indoors instead!

quests.instruction: Someone takes your toy without asking. How do you feel?
quests.hint: When something feels unfair, your face might scrunch up.
quests.explanation: It feels very unfair when someone takes your things without asking first.
quests.funFact: Using your words to say 'please ask first' can help solve problems calmly.

quests.instruction: Tomorrow is finally your birthday party! How do you feel?
quests.hint: Counting down the days to a big celebration can make you want to bounce.
quests.explanation: Waiting for a special day like your birthday fills you with bubbly energy.
quests.funFact: This feeling can give your body a fun burst of extra energy!

quests.instruction: You get a big hug from your mom. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Think about how warm and cozy hugs make you feel inside.
quests.explanation: A warm hug from someone you love makes your heart feel warm and happy.
quests.funFact: Hugs can help your body feel calm and safe — that is why they feel so nice!

quests.instruction: You spot a big spider sitting in the bathtub. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Finding a creepy critter somewhere you did not expect can make you freeze for a second.
quests.explanation: Finding a critter somewhere unexpected can give you a sudden, jumpy feeling.
quests.funFact: Asking a grown-up for help with spiders is a smart, brave choice!

quests.instruction: Your sandwich falls into a mud puddle at lunchtime. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Losing your lunch right when you are hungry can make your face droop.
quests.explanation: Losing your food, especially when you are hungry, can leave you feeling down.
quests.funFact: A hug or a snack swap from a friend can turn this feeling around quickly!

quests.instruction: Your video game keeps losing your saved progress. How do you feel?
quests.hint: When something keeps going wrong again and again, you might stomp your foot.
quests.explanation: When the same problem keeps happening, it is normal to feel frustrated.
quests.funFact: Saving your game often can help stop this frustrating problem from happening.

quests.instruction: You are about to unwrap a big, mysterious present. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Not knowing what is inside a wrapped gift can make your hands feel eager.
quests.explanation: Not knowing what is inside a gift makes the moment feel extra thrilling.
quests.funFact: The fun feeling of surprise is part of why gift-giving feels so special!

quests.instruction: Your best friend comes over to play all afternoon. How do you feel?
quests.hint: Spending time with your best friend is always something to smile about.
quests.explanation: Playing with your best friend fills your afternoon with happy fun.
quests.funFact: Good friends can make an ordinary day feel extra special!
